row.name: Force Push/Pull
row.effect: Exert a telekinetic force equal to your Basic Lift (BL) on objects within 10 feet. Cannot inflict damage directly.

levels.name: Force Push/Pull

levels.name: Force Push/Pull
levels.description: The Force-user can telekinetically push or pull objects and beings.

levels.name: Force Push/Pull
levels.description: The Force-user can telekinetically push or pull objects and beings.

levels.name: Force Push/Pull
